'''Ptak-Sok''' was a [[Arachnoid]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] who was associated with three other smugglers: [[Bruce Mercy]], [[Morph]], and [[Durquist]].

==Behind the scenes==
Ptak-Sok appeared in the adventure [[Treasure Hunt (adventure)|Treasure Hunt]], published in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. His name is pronounced as "Patahk-Sook".<ref name="TH" />
